answer:
The governor who passed a law in honor of Donda West was **Arnold Schwarzenegger**. He signed the "Donda West Law" in 2009, which made it mandatory for patients in California to receive medical clearance through a physical examination before undergoing elective cosmetic surgery. This legislation was named in memory of Dr. Donda West, the mother of rapper Kanye West, who died in 2007 following complications from cosmetic surgery.

Arnold Schwarzenegger was married to **Maria Shriver** from 1986 until their divorce was finalized in 2021 (they had separated in 2011). Maria Shriver is a well-known journalist and was the First Lady of California during Schwarzenegger's tenure as governor. They had four children together.
